name.ja: クイックモデル ブリッツガンダム

series.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED

description.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム SEED」に登場する「ブリッツガンダム」がクイックガンダムモデルで登場。彩色済みなので組み立てるだけで機体色を再現。関節はABS製で様々なアクションポーズが再現可能。右腕に「トリケロス」、左腕に「グレイプニール」を装備。グレイプニールはパーツの差し替えでツメの開閉を再現。
description.en: "Blitz Gundam " that appears in " Mobile Suit Gundam SEED " is now available as a quick Gundam Model. Since it is already colored, you can reproduce the aircraft color just by assembling it. The joints are made of ABS and various action poses can be reproduced. Equipped with " Triceros " on the right arm and " Gleipnir" on the left arm. Grape Neil reproduces the opening and closing of the claw by replacing parts.
